structured.feedback: The description is about 190 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the product details, and it leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are that it calls the formula "BPA-free" when the bottle is, and that it blurs features and benefits.
